title: Study and learning
about: Collocations for school, college and courses: more precise alternatives to do and get (sit an exam, carry out research, be awarded a degree), the more formal verbs teachers use (attend lectures, hand in an essay, submit an application) and terms such as continuous assessment and higher education.

parts.title: More collocations connected with study and learning
Common mistakes
parts.note: Pass an exam — це успішно скласти іспит. Якщо іспит у тебе ще попереду, кажи I'm taking / sitting an exam. Домашнє завдання робимо з do, а не з make. У таблиці — ще кілька пасток, коли говориш про навчання.

rows: I'm passing an exam on Friday
I'm sitting / taking an exam on Friday

items.pattern: sit / take an exam / a test (in sth) · sit – sat – sat · informal: do an exam
items.meaning: do an exam or test; it says nothing about whether you pass
items.example: I'm **taking an exam** in Spanish next Saturday, so I can't come to the party.
more: If you're not ready, you can **take the test** next month instead.
Students who are ill on the day can **sit the exam** in the autumn.
items.watchOut: «Складаю (здаю) іспит» — I'm sitting / taking an exam. Pass an exam — успішно скласти, тож «I'm passing an exam tomorrow» звучить так, ніби ти вже знаєш результат. У розмові британці кажуть і do an exam.

items.pattern: carry out / conduct research / a research project / a survey (into / on sth) · research is uncountable
items.meaning: do a careful study of something to find out new facts
items.example: Before we opened the café, we **carried out some research** into what people in the area wanted.
more: Doctors are **conducting research** into why some children get more colds than others.
Our library **carried out a survey** to find out which books people want.
items.watchOut: Research зазвичай незлічуване: some research, a piece of research, a research project, а не a research. «Проводити дослідження» — carry out / conduct (або do) research, не make research. Прийменник — into або on: research into allergies.

items.pattern: enrol on / take a course (in sth) · enrol – enrolled · AmE enroll in
items.meaning: officially join a course as a student
items.example: Last autumn I **enrolled on a pottery course** at the arts centre.
more: Dad **took a course** in first aid after his grandson was born.
My neighbour has **enrolled on a course** in garden design.
items.watchOut: «Записатися на курси» — enrol on a course (британське) або enroll in a course (американське), не write on / record on a course. У розмові — sign up for a course. Британське написання: enrol, enrolled, enrolment.

items.pattern: study for / take a degree / diploma (in sth) · a degree in law = a law degree
items.meaning: be a student on a university or college course that leads to a degree or diploma
items.uk: навчатися на бакалавра (магістра); здобувати ступінь, диплом
items.example: After ten years as a nurse, she decided to **study for a degree** in psychology.
more: My cousin is **taking a diploma** in hotel management at the local college.
He's **studying for a law degree** and working in a shop at weekends.
items.watchOut: «Він навчається на юриста» — he's studying law / he's studying for a law degree, не he's learning for a lawyer. Degree тут — освітній ступінь (бакалавр, магістр), а не «градус». Diploma у Британії — зазвичай коротша програма, нижча за degree.

items.pattern: study / take history / economics / maths (at school / at university) · informal: do history
items.meaning: have a particular subject as part of your education
items.example: At school I **took chemistry** because I wanted to be a vet.
more: My son wants to **study geography** at university.
Which subjects are you **taking** next year?
items.watchOut: Про шкільний чи університетський предмет зазвичай кажуть study або take: She's studying law. Learn — про те, що запам'ятовуєш чи вмієш: learn the words, learn to drive. Назви предметів — з малої літери, крім мов: history, maths, але French.

items.pattern: write an essay / assignment / report (on / about sth) · informal: do an essay
items.meaning: produce a piece of written work for a course
items.example: I have to **write an essay** about my favourite book by Monday.
more: The tutor asks us to **write an assignment** every fortnight.
She stayed up till two in the morning **writing her essay**.
items.watchOut: Assignment — навчальне завдання, часто письмова робота; з асигнуваннями не пов'язане. «Писати есе» — write an essay, не make an essay.

items.pattern: give a lecture / talk (on / about sth) (to sb) · formal: deliver a lecture
items.meaning: speak to an audience about a subject
items.example: A police officer **gave a talk** on road safety at our school.
more: Professor Hill **gives a lecture** on Roman history every Thursday morning.
I've been asked to **give a short talk** about my trip to Japan at the library.
items.watchOut: «Читати лекцію» — give a lecture, не read a lecture: read sb a lecture — «прочитати комусь нотацію». «Виступити з доповіддю» — give a talk, не make a talk.

items.pattern: obtain a degree / diploma · be awarded a degree / diploma (in sth) · formal; informal: get a degree
items.meaning: successfully finish a course and officially receive a degree or diploma
items.example: My grandmother **was awarded a diploma** in nursing in 1975.
more: She **obtained her degree** in economics from a university in Scotland.
Only students who pass every module **are awarded a diploma**.
items.watchOut: Award — коли університет видає диплом: The university awarded her a degree → She was awarded a degree. Не плутай з reward — винагородити. У розмові просто get a degree.

items.pattern: receive / be given a grade / mark (for sth) · get an A / a B
items.meaning: get a particular result for a piece of work or an exam
items.example: My son's science project **was given the top grade** in his class.
more: Every essay **receives a grade** from A to E.
She **received a B** in the end-of-year test and was a bit disappointed.
items.watchOut: Оцінка — a grade або (британське) a mark, не an estimate. «Поставити оцінку» — give a grade / mark, не put a mark.

items.pattern: obtain / acquire / gain a qualification (in sth) · formal; informal: get a qualification
items.meaning: successfully finish the training or exams that show you can do a particular job
items.example: To work in a nursery, you need to **acquire a qualification** in childcare.
more: My brother **obtained his plumbing qualification** after two years of evening classes.
It's never too late to **gain a new qualification**.
items.watchOut: Qualifications (часто в множині) — документи про освіту й фах: What qualifications do you have? — «Яка у вас освіта?». Acquire і obtain звучать формально; у розмові — get або gain a qualification.

items.pattern: receive / get / have a good / basic / university education
items.meaning: be taught at school, college or university
items.example: My great-grandparents left school at twelve and never **received a proper education**.
more: My parents worked hard so that we could **receive a good education**.
She **received her education** at a small village school in Wales.
items.watchOut: Education тут без множини: a good education, а не educations. «Отримати освіту» — receive / get an education, не take an education. «Вища освіта» — higher education, не high education.

items.pattern: pass an exam / a test ↔ fail an exam / a test
items.meaning: be successful in an exam or test
items.example: If you **pass the exam**, you'll get a certificate.
more: He **passed all his exams** and is off to university in September.
I **failed** my first driving test but **passed** the second time.
items.watchOut: Pass — тільки успішно скласти. «Завтра складаю іспит» — I'm taking / sitting an exam tomorrow, не I'm passing an exam. «Провалити (не скласти) іспит» — fail an exam.

items.pattern: do your / some homework · homework is uncountable
items.meaning: do the work a teacher gives you to finish at home
items.example: I usually **do my homework** as soon as I get home from school.
more: We used to **do our homework** together at the kitchen table.
I'll **do some homework** on the train tomorrow morning.
items.watchOut: «Робити домашнє» — do your homework, не make your homework. Homework незлічуване: a lot of homework, a piece of homework, не homeworks і не a homework. Не плутай з housework — хатня робота.

items.pattern: attend a lecture / a class / a course / a meeting · no preposition after attend · less formal: go to
items.meaning: be present at a lecture, class etc., often regularly
items.example: My dad **attends a painting class** every Wednesday evening.
more: Last term I **attended every single class**, even when I had a cold.
If you can't **attend a lesson**, let your teacher know in advance.
items.watchOut: «Відвідувати заняття» — attend classes, не visit classes: visit — про людей і місця (visit my aunt, visit Rome). Після attend прийменника немає: attend the lecture, не attend to the lecture (attend to — займатися чимось). Assist — це «допомагати», а не «бути присутнім».

items.pattern: complete a course / a degree / your studies · less formal: finish
items.meaning: finish a course, doing everything it requires
items.example: You'll receive a certificate when you **complete the course**.
more: Grandad **completed an online course** in photography at the age of seventy.
She **completed her studies** in Kyiv and then moved to Lviv.
items.watchOut: «Закінчити курс, навчання» — complete або finish a course. End a course зазвичай кажуть про школу, яка припиняє курс. Fulfil — виконати (обіцянку, умову), а не закінчити навчання.

items.pattern: a class / an exam / a meeting is held (in a place / on a day) · hold – held – held
items.meaning: takes place; is organised to happen (formal)
items.example: The yoga class **is held** in the village hall on Tuesday evenings.
more: Where will the final exam **be held**?
Parents' evenings **are held** twice a year at our school.
items.watchOut: «Заняття проходить у кімнаті 12» — the class is held / takes place in Room 12, не the class passes in Room 12. У такому значенні hold зазвичай у пасиві: is held, will be held.

items.pattern: hand in an essay / your homework / an assignment · hand sth in · hand it in
items.meaning: give a piece of work to a teacher so they can mark it
items.example: Don't forget to **hand in your essay** before you leave on Friday.
more: I **handed my homework in** two days late and lost marks for it.
Has everyone **handed in** their application forms?
items.watchOut: «Здати роботу» — hand in (або give in; в американській — turn in), не pass an essay. Займенник — посередині: hand it in, не hand in it. Hand out — навпаки, роздати.

items.pattern: submit an application / a form / your work (to sb) (by a date) · formal; less formal: send in / put in
items.meaning: officially send or give a document so that it can be considered
items.example: You must **submit your application** for the summer school by 31 May.
more: My son **submitted his university application** two days before the deadline.
**Submit** your homework through the school website by Sunday.
items.watchOut: «Подати заяву, документи» — submit an application (або send in / put in an application), не serve an application: serve — подавати страву. Після submit частка in не потрібна: submit your application, але send in your application.

items.pattern: withdraw from a course / university · withdraw – withdrew – withdrawn · formal; less formal: leave a course, drop out (of sth)
items.meaning: officially stop being a student on a course before it ends
items.example: Three people **withdrew from the course** after the first month because the timetable didn't suit them.
more: If you **withdraw from the course** before October, you'll get your money back.
Illness forced her to **withdraw from university** in her second year.
items.watchOut: Після withdraw потрібне from: withdraw from the course. Leave — без прийменника: leave the course. «Відмовитися від курсу» — не refuse from the course. Withdraw money — зняти гроші з рахунку.

items.pattern: keep a notebook / a diary / a record (of sth)
items.meaning: regularly write things in a notebook so that you have a record of them
items.example: Since I started to **keep a vocabulary notebook**, I forget far fewer new words.
more: I **keep a notebook** of recipes my mum tells me on the phone.
She's **kept a diary** since she was twelve.
items.watchOut: «Вести щоденник, зошит» — keep a diary / a notebook, не lead a diary і не hold a notebook. Так само keep a record of sth — вести облік, записувати.

items.pattern: the first / final draft (of sth) · write / do a draft
items.meaning: the first version of a piece of writing, which you will improve / the finished version
items.example: I wrote the **first draft** of my speech for my brother's wedding on the train.
more: The **final draft** was much shorter and clearer than the first one.
Could you read the **first draft** of my cover letter and tell me what you think?
items.watchOut: Чернетка — a (first) draft. «Чистовик» — the final draft або the final version, не a white draft. Британське draught — це протяг або розливне пиво; про текст пишуть draft.

items.pattern: give (sb) feedback (on sth) · get / receive feedback · feedback is uncountable
items.meaning: tell someone what was good about their work and what could be better
items.example: My piano teacher **gives me feedback** after every lesson.
more: Could you **give me some feedback** on my CV before I send it?
We **got** really useful **feedback** from customers about the new menu.
items.watchOut: Feedback незлічуване: some feedback, a lot of feedback, не a feedback і не feedbacks. «Дати зворотний зв'язок» — give feedback, не make feedback. Прийменник — on: feedback on my essay.

items.pattern: continuous assessment (of sth) · be assessed by / through continuous assessment
items.meaning: a way of judging students by their work during the whole course, not by one final exam
items.example: The cookery course has no final exam: it uses **continuous assessment**.
more: I prefer **continuous assessment** because I always panic in exams.
With **continuous assessment**, every piece of homework counts towards your final mark.
items.watchOut: «Поточне оцінювання» — continuous (або continual) assessment, не current чи permanent assessment: так цю систему не називають. Assessment — оцінювання загалом; оцінка за окрему роботу — a mark або a grade.

items.pattern: provide / give / offer training (in sth / for sb) · provide sb with training · training is uncountable
items.meaning: give people the teaching they need for a job or a skill
items.example: The supermarket **provides training** in food safety for all new staff.
more: The council **provides free training** for people who want to become childminders.
Does your company **provide** any **training** in first aid?
items.watchOut: «Проводити навчання, тренінг» — provide / give / offer training, не make a training. Training тут незлічуване: some training, не a training чи trainings. Після provide sb — with: provide staff with training.

items.pattern: higher / tertiary education · go on to / go into higher education · tertiary is formal
items.meaning: education at a university or college, usually to degree level
items.example: Neither of my grandparents had the chance to go into **higher education**.
more: **Higher education** isn't only for young people: our neighbour started university at fifty.
In most countries, **tertiary education** starts at eighteen or nineteen.
items.watchOut: «Вища освіта» — higher education, не high education. High school — середня школа (переважно в США), а не вищий навчальний заклад. Tertiary — формальне слово.

items.pattern: further education · a further education (FE) college · BrE
items.meaning: education for people who have left school but are not at university, often practical or for a job
items.example: At forty, my aunt took a **further education** course in hairdressing.
more: Our town's **further education** college runs evening classes in plumbing and car mechanics.
Lots of adults go back to **further education** to learn new skills.
items.watchOut: Further education у Британії — не вища освіта: це навчання після школи в коледжі, часто професійне (кухар, електрик, перукар). Університет — це higher education. Не плутай further і farther: farther — про відстань.

items.pattern: recognise a qualification / a degree / an exam · a recognised qualification · AmE recognize
items.meaning: officially accept that a qualification is valid
items.example: Before you pay for the course, check that the certificate is **recognised** by employers.
more: Her Polish nursing degree **is recognised** in every EU country.
He has a **recognised qualification** in carpentry, so he found work quickly.
items.watchOut: «Визнавати диплом» — recognise a qualification, не admit і не confess: admit — визнати свою провину чи помилку (admit a mistake). Британське написання — recognise, recognised; американське — recognize.

warmup.uk: Цього тижня мій син складає випускні іспити.
warmup.q: My son is ___ his final exams this week.
warmup.explain: Складати іспит — take або sit an exam. Pass — успішно скласти, а результату ще ніхто не знає.
Робити домашнє — do your homework, не make.
Відвідувати лекції — attend (або go to). Visit — про людей і місця, assist — допомагати.

warmup.uk: Завтра професорка читатиме лекцію про сучасне мистецтво.
warmup.q: Tomorrow the professor is ___ a lecture on modern art.
warmup.explain: Читати лекцію — give a lecture. Read sb a lecture — прочитати комусь нотацію.
Здати роботу — hand in. Pass — скласти іспит, hand out — роздати.

warmup.uk: Наша школа проводить дослідження харчових звичок дітей.
warmup.q: Our school is ___ research into children's eating habits.
warmup.explain: Проводити дослідження — conduct / carry out (або do) research. Make research — калька.

warmup.uk: Я веду зошит для нових слів.
warmup.q: I ___ a notebook for new words.
warmup.explain: Вести зошит, щоденник — keep a notebook / a diary. Lead — калька з «вести».

warmup.q: Mum has ___ on an Italian course.
warmup.explain: Записатися на курс — enrol on (або sign up for) a course.

A.q: Great news: you've ___ the exam with a really high mark!
A.explain: Pass — успішно скласти. Sit / take — просто складати, результат ще невідомий.

A.q: The supermarket ___ out research to find out what customers think of its new bread.
A.explain: Carry out (conduct, do) research — проводити дослідження. Make research — калька.

A.q: Each project was ___ a mark out of ten by the judges.
A.explain: Отримати оцінку — be given (receive) a mark / grade. «Поставити оцінку» — give a mark, не put.

B.q: Half the class didn't ___ the morning lecture because of the snow.
B.explain: Відвідувати лекцію — attend (або go to). Visit — про людей і місця, assist — допомагати.

B.q: Please hand ___ your homework before you leave.
B.explain: Hand in — здати роботу вчителю. Hand out — навпаки, роздати.

B.q: Sam had to ___ from his chemistry course when his dad became ill.
B.explain: Withdraw from — офіційно покинути курс. Leave і quit — без from: leave the course.

C.q: Fees for ___ education have gone up again, so many students work part-time.
C.explain: Вища освіта — higher education (формально — tertiary education).

C.q: The teacher ___ us some useful feedback on our presentations.
C.explain: Дати відгук — give feedback (або provide, offer). Make / do feedback не кажуть.

C.q: Our college only accepts students whose school certificates are ___ by the Ministry of Education.
C.explain: Визнавати диплом, атестат — recognise. Admit, confess — визнати провину.

example.title: Back to college
example.uk:
Минулого вересня моя мама записалася на вечірній курс бухгалтерії в місцевому коледжі професійної освіти. Заняття проводили по вівторках і четвергах, і вона відвідала кожне з них.

Іспитів не було: на курсі було поточне оцінювання. Кожні два тижні вона мала писати письмову роботу, і викладач давав їй відгук на кожну. Чернетки вона завжди писала за кухонним столом, поки я поруч робив домашнє завдання.

У червні вона здала останню роботу й завершила курс. Тепер у неї є визнана кваліфікація, а наступного року вона хоче навчатися на бакалавра. Я ще ніколи не бачив її такою щасливою.
example.en:
Last September my mum [[enrolled on|a3]] an evening course in accounting at the local [[further education|c7]] college. The classes [[were held|b3]] on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and she [[attended|b1]] every single one.

There were no exams: the course used [[continuous assessment|c4]]. Every fortnight she had to [[write an assignment|a6]], and the tutor [[gave her feedback|c3]] on each one. She always wrote her [[first drafts|c2]] at the kitchen table while I [[did my homework|a13]] next to her.

In June she [[handed in|b4]] her last piece of work and [[completed the course|b2]]. Now she has a [[recognised qualification|c8]], and next year she wants to [[study for a degree|a4]]. I've never seen her so happy.
